english.title: Carry on a s.13(2) activity without the authority of a s.13 licence - Animal Welfare Act 2006
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) carried on an activity described in section 13(2) of the Animal Welfare Act 2006, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACTIVITY..), without the authority of a licence for that purpose issued under section 13 of the Act
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 13(6) and 32(2) of the Animal Welfare Act 2006.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
Section 13(2) applies to an activity which:-
(a) involves animals for which a person is responsible, and (b) is specified for the purposes of the subsection by regulations made by the appropriate national authority.

other.timelimitforprosecutions: Complex see section 31 of the Act
other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

NOTE:
Section 32(5) of the Animal Welfare Act 2006 provides that In relation to an offence committed before the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the reference to 51 weeks is to be read as a reference to 6 months.

Time Limit on Prosecutions:
Complex see legislation

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
